mutations.cell: 10b the retried cancel finishes the removal as already gone

mutations.name: a take carries the endpoint's newest epoch instead of the one its copy was read under

mutations.note: A take that reads the endpoint's stream time when it runs, instead of when its copy arrived, sends the new stream's time for a copy buffered from the old one once a refusal has refreshed it.
